title: Telemetry agent-run record
description: One completed agent invocation's usage/cost/outcome summary, emitted after the subprocess exits. Transport-agnostic: the emitter hands this record to a configured sink, it does not itself know about any specific collector. additionalProperties:false, mechanical whitelist.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this run record (e.g. a UUID).

spawn_id.description: Opaque identifier for the spawn that produced this run. Shape is caller-defined.

initiator.description: Freeform label for what triggered this dispatch (e.g. 'operator', 'cli', 'scheduled'). Loadout does not enumerate a fixed set — the deployment's dispatch surface defines its own initiator vocabulary.

host.description: Hostname the run executed on. Optional — omit when the deployment does not want host attribution in the record.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run started.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run finished.

model_used.description: Identifier of the primary model used for this run. Optional — omit when unknown.

billing_mode.description: Freeform label for the billing arrangement in effect (e.g. 'api', 'subscription'). Deployment-defined vocabulary.

pr_url.description: URL of the PR this run produced, if any. Optional.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the emitter recorded this event (may differ from finished_at if emission is deferred).
